lede: Monday night, Telluride Town Council votes on the 2027 budget and the property tax levy that funds it — and tucked into that same meeting is a second reading of an ordinance that would suspend the Open Space Fund's 5% cut of Real Estate Transfer Tax revenue for the year, a real tension between tight finances and the town's conservation commitments worth showing up for. Norwood's Planning and Zoning Commission also digs into Land Use Code and Master Plan updates Monday, the kind of foundational work that shapes what gets built for years. Ouray City Council meanwhile votes on its own 2027 budget package, mill levy, and fee schedule, and over in Ouray County the BOCC takes up a resolution repealing austerity measures alongside a new AI governance policy.

notable.stake: Land Use Code and Master Plan updates shape Norwood's future development rules.
Ouray votes on 2027 budget, mill levy, fee schedule, and Ice Park agreement.
Telluride votes on 2027 budget, tax levy, and Open Space Fund suspension ordinance.
